title: CS31006: Computer Networks
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Introduction to networks and layered architecture. Data communication concepts,
transmission media and topology, multiplexing. circuit switching and packet
switching, data link layer, layer 2 switches and ATM switches, SONET/SDH.
Medium access control. CSMA CD, TDMA, FDMA, CDMA. Network layer and addressing,
IP version 4 and 6. Routing algorithms. Transmission layer, TCP and UDP.
Congestion control techniques. WAN, ATM. Internetworking. Wireless
communications. Network management and security.
